metadata.description: Primary references for CLI, SDK, IDE extension, language-server, and package publishing work, including current registry-publishing security practices.
metadata.title: Software Devtools - Sources

sdk_and_cli.name: OpenAPI Specification
sdk_and_cli.description: Source contract for schema-driven SDK and client generation.

sdk_and_cli.name: Cobra
sdk_and_cli.description: Go CLI framework and UX conventions for subcommand-oriented tools.

sdk_and_cli.name: Typer
sdk_and_cli.description: Python CLI framework with type-driven argument handling.

sdk_and_cli.name: oclif
sdk_and_cli.description: JavaScript/TypeScript CLI framework for plugin-friendly tools.

sdk_and_cli.name: Language Server Protocol
sdk_and_cli.description: Official LSP overview and specification entrypoint for multi-editor language tooling.

mcp.name: Model Context Protocol (spec)
mcp.description: Canonical Model Context Protocol: concepts, architecture, ecosystem. The dominant 2026 pattern for connecting AI apps/agents to external tools and data.

mcp.name: MCP — Build a Server
mcp.description: Official guide to building MCP servers (exposing tools/data to AI agents). Resolve current SDK and tooling at use-time.

mcp.name: MCP — Build a Client
mcp.description: Official guide to building MCP clients. Relevant for SDK/CLI products exposing or consuming agent tool surfaces.

mcp.name: Official MCP Registry
mcp.description: Official metadata registry for publicly discoverable MCP servers; in preview since late 2025, ~10k server records by mid-2026. Points to npm/PyPI/etc. packages rather than hosting them.

ide_and_publishing.name: VS Code Extension API
ide_and_publishing.description: Primary docs for editor extensions, activation, and publishing.

ide_and_publishing.name: npm Package Publishing
ide_and_publishing.description: Official npm packaging and publishing guidance.

ide_and_publishing.name: npm Provenance Statements
ide_and_publishing.description: Official npm provenance, attestations, and verification guidance for secure package publishing.

ide_and_publishing.name: npm Trusted Publishing
ide_and_publishing.description: Official npm trusted-publishing (OIDC) guidance; reached general availability mid-2025 and is the current recommended alternative to long-lived publish tokens for GitHub Actions and GitLab CI.

ide_and_publishing.name: CISA Advisory — npm Supply Chain Compromise (Shai-Hulud)
ide_and_publishing.description: Government advisory on the Shai-Hulud self-propagating npm worm (Sept 2025, second wave Nov 2025); baseline threat model for publish-credential and install-script hardening.

ide_and_publishing.name: PyPI Packaging Guide
ide_and_publishing.description: Python packaging, distribution metadata, and publishing workflow.

ide_and_publishing.name: crates.io Policies
ide_and_publishing.description: Rust crate publishing and package metadata guidance.

ide_and_publishing.name: NuGet Package Publishing
ide_and_publishing.description: Official NuGet package publishing workflow and API-key handling guidance.

ide_and_publishing.name: Maven Central Publisher Portal
ide_and_publishing.description: Official Maven Central publisher portal guide for artifact validation and release workflow.
